verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents that a spouse or children can be added to the primary legal package at a standardized flat rate, so dependent coverage is part of the service. The parole page also references founders living in the U.S. with their families. However, the specific dependent categories in the story (O-3, H-4) and spousal work authorization are never named. Missing for 10: explicit O-3/H-4 dependent visa documentation, spousal work-authorization (EAD) coverage, details of what the dependent add-on includes, independent corroboration.
